# EBS pollock 2026 {#ebs-pollock-2026}

**Model scope:** Model 26.0 (Rceattle) is the primary model. Model 23.0 provides continuity and comparison. This public checklist contains task descriptions and completion criteria; assessment results and draft files remain private.

The requested inputs are fishery catch, BTS, ATS and AVO indices through 2026; BTS and ATS ages through 2026; and fishery ages through 2025. Preserve each series' actual observation years. Retain the absent 2020 BTS, the corrected ATS 2020 age-1 treatment, and zero composition weight for the absent ATS 2020 age sample.

## Ten data gaps and completion criteria

[Download the data-gap checklist (CSV)](data/assessment-data-gaps.csv) · [Task register (JSON)](data/assessment-tasks.json)

| Task | Initial status | Completion criteria |
|---|---|---|
| Finalize 2025 catch and update 2026 catch | Waiting | Record source, extraction date, units, retained/discarded and CDQ treatment; reconcile final 2025 catch; document the 2026 year-end estimate and its completion method. |
| Update BTS 2025–2026 indices and covariance | To do | Verify actual survey years and coverage; retain estimates, covariance or supplied uncertainty, method version, and comparison with the previous series. Preserve the absent 2020 BTS. |
| Update ATS 2026 index and age-1 series | To do | Validate units, delivered uncertainty, revision, and actual survey years. Preserve the corrected ATS 2020 age-1 treatment and keep the missing placeholder outside fitting. |
| Update AVO index through 2026 | To do | Record processing revision, observation years, coverage and uncertainty; compare revised historical values and document the approved uncertainty treatment. |
| Update BTS age compositions through 2026 | To do | Retain actual survey years, age range, sample sizes, expansion method, age-reading provenance and uncertainty; validate composition totals and years against the index inputs. |
| Receive final ATS 2026 age compositions | Waiting | Confirm final delivery and age-reading method; validate compositions, age range, sample sizes and uncertainty. Preserve zero composition weight for the absent ATS 2020 age sample. |
| Update fishery ages for 2024 and 2025 | To do | Record fish and haul counts, strata, expansion, age-reading method, uncertainty and revision; validate the terminal composition year as 2025 and preserve source age-method labels. |
| Update biological and weight-at-age schedules | To do | Compare each schedule with the baseline; document sources, units, years, missing-year assumptions, and the rationale for any change. Record cohort and year-effect sigma inputs; compare weight estimates and forecasts between Models 23.0 and 26.0; document forecast-year alignment and weight-uncertainty treatment. |
| Document ageing error and composition weights | To do | Archive matrices and age methods; distinguish sampled fish, starting sample sizes and final likelihood weights; document all adjustments and preserve zero ATS 2020 composition weight. |
| Validate and freeze matched model inputs | To do | Check source revisions, observation schedules, dimensions, units, sums, missingness, ageing error and weights; record changes, checksums and the selected input versions before fitting. |

The catch task waits for the October 1 query and a documented full-year completion estimate. The ATS age task waits for the final 2026 delivery. Move a card to Done after checking its completion criteria and recording the dated evidence in the assessment workspace.

## Plan Team diagnostics

- [ ] Age-1 BTS selectivity: evaluate alternative penalties and a time-invariant alternative.
- [ ] Simulated-data retrospectives: simulate from fitted Model 26.0, refit, and perform peels.
- [ ] Selectivity across peels: examine retrospective changes in time-varying selectivity.
- [ ] Paired retrospectives: present Models 23.0 and 26.0 with matched data cutoffs and peel years.
- [ ] BTS data influence: examine index volatility, the missing 2020 survey, and supported data or ecosystem explanations.
- [ ] Composition weighting: document starting and final weights and evaluate alternatives with OSA diagnostics.

For each analysis, retain settings, numerical diagnostics, outputs, interpretation and the response to the recommendation. Continue future ESP material as resources allow.

## Legacy workspace retirement

**Status:** Done. The `ebswp_assessment` repository is archived read-only after a verified private backup. Useful 2025 inputs were retained pending validation, and the local source was preserved. Validate the retained inputs before assessment use.

The [22-package inventory](packages.html) provides package versions, repository and documentation links. It supports finding the software relevant to each task. Package inclusion records its presence in the R-universe listing; available versions and failed attempts are distinguished. Model validation belongs with the selected assessment run.
